params.val: N% of the holder's max HP — 25% for Substitute itself, 50% for a Substitute created by Shed Tail; whichever move/effect creates it decides N
N% max HP, paid immediately as the cost of creating it (same N as the set above)
holder's current HP is at or below N% of max HP — cannot afford to create it; also always fails if the holder's max HP is 1 (Shedinja), regardless of current HP

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts substitute onTryHit): the maxhp===1 case is a separate hard-coded check (the "Shedinja clause"), not just an edge case of the percentage rule — a 1-max-HP Pokémon's current HP can never be low enough to trip the generic threshold, so without this explicit clause it would incorrectly be able to make a Substitute. This clause was missing from the entry.
incoming damage is subtracted from substitute_hp instead of the holder's own HP
the move ignores Substitute — moves individually flagged to bypass it

verified via Showdown source (moves.ts, flags.bypasssub): broader than "sound moves + Infiltrator" as previously written — sound moves (Boomburst, Hyper Voice, etc.) do carry this flag, but so do ~45 non-damaging status moves that target the substitute-holder directly and need to land regardless (Taunt, Encore, Disable, Whirlwind, Curse, Foresight, Attract, and others), plus a few damaging outliers (Hyperspace Fury/Hole, Spectral Thief). Infiltrator is a separate check (move.infiltrates), not part of the bypasssub flag itself.
Substitute breaks; any damage beyond what remained on substitute_hp is wasted, not passed through to the holder
